Subject: MAP kickoff: Redwood MAP draft & timeline options

Thanks again for the time today, Sophie — great conversation and really appreciate the clarity on the use cases and constraints. Per our discovery, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to help align on milestones, owners, and a target close window. Attached is Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf and I dropped a copy of my notes as Discovery-Notes-20260830.txt in case it's helpful.

High-level recap (from today):
- Primary use case: clinical triage assistant to summarize intake and suggest next steps for RN workflow.
- KPI: reduce triage time by ~20% and auto-suggested disposition accuracy > 85% by pilot end.
- Data: PHI will remain in your VPC Private deployment. KMS integration is required.
- Stakeholders: Sophie Turner (Clinical Lead), Rajesh Iyer (IT/Cloud), Procurement (procurement@luminahealth.com).

MAP draft (summary):
1) Pilot kickoff (Milestone) — internal integration + sandbox testing
   - Target date: Sep 15, 2026
   - Redwood owner: Marissa Cole (PM/CS lead)
   - Lumina owner: Rajesh Iyer (IT lead)
   - Dependencies: VPC peering & KMS key exchange; sample data for validation

2) Pilot execution: 4-week pilot with monitored metrics
   - Target date: Oct 13, 2026 (pilot complete)
   - Redwood owner: Aditya Rao (SRE/SE)
   - Lumina owner: Sophie Turner (Clinical SME)
   - Dependencies: access to EHR sample feed; decision on inference capacity (dedicated vs hosted)

3) Evaluation & go/no-go decision
   - Target date: Oct 20, 2026
   - Redwood owner: Vivek Kulkarni (AE)
   - Lumina owner: Exec sponsor (TBD)
   - Dependencies: evaluation results, executive approval, procurement terms

Proposed target close: Nov 1, 2026 (contract signed for initial Dedicated capacity + support).

Options on timeline: we can accelerate the pilot start to Sep 1 if Lumina can provide VPC peering and KMS keys by Aug 28; otherwise Sep 15 is a conservative start.

Asks / next steps:
- Please confirm the MAP owners above and add any missing stakeholders (legal/procurement contacts).
- Confirm which timeline you prefer: Accelerated (Sep 1) or Standard (Sep 15).
- If acceptable, I'll open a HubSpot MAP record and send a calendar invite for the MAP kickoff meeting (30 min) next week.

Drive links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=map-draft-lumina
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf, Discovery-Notes-20260830.txt

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,

- Add Legal: I'll loop in our counsel (karen.liu@luminahealth.com) — would you like them CC'd on the MAP doc?
- Timeline: Standard (Sep 15) is safer given internal change windows, but we will try to accelerate and aim for Sep 1 if Rajesh can get keys/provisioning done by Aug 28.
